About

CAB Steel Metal Fabrication is a trusted Batangas based supplier providing durable, affordable metal roofing for homes and construction projects.

We handle all fabrication in house to guarantee consistent quality, custom size cuts, and fast turnaround times. To suit every budget, our lineup features high premium sheets from Genuine APO Galfan alongside our flexible CAB Steel Original and CAB Steel Economy.

Why choose us

Every roofing sheet is roll formed in house for dependable thickness, custom length cutting, and direct factory value.

Frequently asked questions

Yes. We custom cut every sheet to your required length in either feet or meters at our Taal warehouse. This saves you cutting labor on site and ensures you only pay for what you actually need.

Premium uses Genuine 0.5 mm APO Galfan coil by Puyat Steel with a 95% zinc and 5% aluminum coating for maximum rust resistance. Original provides dependable 0.5 mm prepainted steel for everyday residential value. Economy is a budget friendly 0.4 mm option designed for carports, sheds, and practical extensions.

Long Span (8 Ribs) provides wide coverage, high strength, and quick installation on homes, warehouses, and commercial buildings. Tile Span replicates the classic look of traditional roof tiles with the lightweight durability of steel.

Delivery is free within 3 km of our Taal warehouse in Barangay Halang. For sites beyond 3 km across Batangas, delivery is computed at an affordable ₱150 per excess kilometer.
